auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Enter your email, then paste the code from Mailpit. Do not click email links.
auth.sent: Code sent. Copy it from Mailpit (http://127.0.0.1:54324) and paste below.
auth.error: Could not sign in. Try again.
auth.pkceHint: Ignore any link in the email — only the numeric code works locally.

onboarding.title: A few details about you
onboarding.subtitle: We use these to personalize the app and apply age rules for your country later. Development only for now — nothing is shared outside Pegazus.
onboarding.birthYearHint: Year only — pick a decade, then a year
onboarding.error: Could not save your profile. Try again.
onboarding.errorName: Enter a name we can use.

age.title: Confirm your birth year
age.subtitle: We use this for age-appropriate consent later. Development only for now.

home.title: Pegazus
home.subtitle: Calm, deliberate algebra practice on your learning path.

path.title: Learning paths
path.subtitle: Pick a path to practice, improve, rebuild, or delete.
path.empty: No paths yet. Create one to get started.
path.deleteConfirm: Delete this path? Your mastery on nodes stays; only this path plan is removed.

pathNew.title: New path
pathNew.subtitle: We’ll draft a plan outline first. Practice content is generated only when you open a skill — from your exam, files, and research.
pathNew.examHint: A short check matched to your goal, age, and any paths you’ve already started — easiest first. Skippable.
pathNew.examRampHint: Questions go from easier to harder so we can find your starting point.
pathNew.examScore: Score {correct}/{total} — used to shape your plan
pathNew.examDoneHint: Results will personalize the outline and content generation.
pathNew.examError: Could not run the placement exam.
pathNew.examNotesHint: Anything we should know — strengths, gaps, or what felt hard.
pathNew.examNotesPlaceholder: e.g. Fine with one-step equations; word problems feel shaky.
pathNew.examPlaceholder: Paste exam text, or upload a PDF/TXT…
pathNew.sourcesHint: Add your notes or syllabus excerpts. Deep research can fill gaps from the licensed corpus.
pathNew.sourcePaste: Or paste another source, then click outside to add
pathNew.goalHint: A short sentence is enough — exam, topic, or skill.
pathNew.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Order food in Spanish, Python loops, the French Revolution
pathNew.profileHint: Check the subject and adjust if needed — this shapes lessons and answer types.
pathNew.profileRefused: We can’t build a path for this goal. Try rephrasing it.
pathNew.profileError: We couldn’t read your goal right now. Try again, or continue and we’ll work it out while building.
pathNew.horizonTitle: How much time do you have?
pathNew.horizonHint: Pick a horizon. We’ll set a target date from today.
pathNew.budgetHint: Short daily sessions beat marathon cramming.
pathNew.recommendTip: For this horizon, about {mins} minutes a day is a steady pace.
pathNew.needConstraint: Choose how long you have, or a daily budget.
pathNew.needDate: Pick a target date, or choose a month horizon.

pathBuilding.title: Building your path
pathBuilding.phaseRead: Reading what you want to learn…
pathBuilding.phaseMatch: Matching milestones on the Algebra graph…

pathDetail.title: Your path
pathDetail.prepareFailed: Could not generate content for this skill.
pathDetail.outlineHint: This is your plan outline. Open a skill to load (or build) that lesson.
pathDetail.redoDiagnosticConfirm: Redo the diagnostic? Mastery on this path’s modules will reset.
pathDetail.improvePlaceholder: e.g. Add more work on inequalities; skip basics I already know
pathDetail.improveHint: We’ll merge this into your goal and rebuild the module list. Mastery on replaced modules resets.
pathDetail.rebuildConfirm: Rebuild this path from the current goal? Module list and mastery on this path will reset.
pathDetail.deleteConfirm: Delete this path? Mastery on nodes stays; only this plan is removed.

diagnostic.title: Diagnostic
diagnostic.subtitle: A few probes so we can skip what you already know.

session.title: Practice
session.hint1: What inverse operation undoes the last change on both sides?
session.hint2: Isolate the variable term first, then divide or multiply.
session.hint3: Look at the constant next to x — undo that operation carefully.
session.verdictUnreadable: We couldn't read that answer. Check it and try again.
session.verdictSolved: Solved! Here is every step of the solution.
session.stepPlaceholder: Next line, or jump to the answer
session.aiPaused: AI hints are paused — using built-in prompts.
session.offline: You are offline. Attempts will sync when you reconnect.
session.prepareWait: Practice unlocks when this lesson finishes building.
session.stageTeach: Lesson ready to read — building practice…
session.practicePreparing: This practice problem is still being prepared. Keep reading or go back — it will appear here shortly.
session.orderHint: Drag the rows, or use the arrow buttons.
session.categorizeHint: Select an item, then choose a group — or drag it onto a group.
session.mapAria: Map of {region} with {count, plural, one {# marked place} other {# marked places}}
session.mapCoords: {lat}° {latDir, select, n {N} other {S}}, {lon}° {lonDir, select, e {E} other {W}}
session.pronounceNoSpeech: No speech detected. Try again or rate yourself.
session.pronounceMicDenied: Microphone access was blocked. You can rate yourself instead.
session.pronounceError: Speech check failed. Try again or rate yourself.
session.pronounceUnsupported: Speech check isn't available in this browser. Say the phrase aloud, then rate yourself.
session.codeBetaHint: The automatic checker is new and may make mistakes.
session.codeEditorHint: Tab inserts 4 spaces. Press Esc, then Tab, to leave the editor.
session.codeTimeout: Time limit reached — check for an infinite loop.
session.codeLoadingPython: Loading Python (about 10 MB, first time only)…
session.codeSubmitHint: Run the tests on your current code before submitting.
session.tutorEmpty: Ask about the idea behind this problem—not for the final answer.
session.tutorPlaceholder: e.g. Why do exponents come before multiplication?
session.tutorCapped: Tutor chat limit for this problem. Use Hint or try a step.

socratic.title: Quick Ask
socratic.subtitle: Up to three Socratic exchanges on one math question — no path progress written.
socratic.limit: That's three exchanges for this question. Start a new one anytime.
socratic.genuiError: Could not load the tutoring canvas.

consent.title: Guardian consent needed
consent.body: Because of your age, a guardian must confirm before you practice or create paths.
consent.devNote: Development only: tap confirm to simulate guardian approval.

rest.title: Short rest.
rest.body: Look away from the screen for a few seconds.
rest.skipBody: Short rests between practice help the brain consolidate what you just did.

priming.title: Focus priming
priming.subtitle: Rest your eyes on the point. Breathe slowly — a short quiet pause before practice.

summary.title: Session complete
summary.subtitle: Quiet progress — no streaks, just mastery.
summary.restNote: Optional: take one more quiet breath before leaving.

account.title: Settings
account.subtitle: Update how Pegazus knows you.
account.saveError: Fill in name, birth year, and country.
account.dangerHelp: Permanently removes your Pegazus data and sign-in.
account.deleteConfirm: This permanently deletes your Pegazus data and auth user. Continue?
account.byoHelp: Encrypted at rest. Never shown again after save. Disabled for minors.
account.byoNoKey: No personal key set — using server default when available.
